pages.title: Making Etherium
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Sanguinite + 1 Alduorite = 2 Etherium

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 2056 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 16.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 6.0.$(br)Enchantability: 30.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 30.

pages.title: Armor: Ethereal
pages.text: Allows the player to clip through walls when sneaking for at most 15 seconds after which the player remains stuck in the wall

pages.title: Weapon: Siphon
pages.text: When attacking, sometimes extra damage is dealt and the user regenerates health equal to the extra damage. If the player has full HP they gain an absorption buff for that amount of hp (Absorption doesn't stack).
